source.title: Transformation of Heart Failure Care: Safe Prescribing and Use of SGLT2 Inhibitors (SGLT2i) in Patients With Stage C & D Heart Failure
source.source_type: ACC clinical infographic / secondary clinical-policy summary

extraction_limitations: This is a one-page secondary clinical infographic and does not report primary trial methods, absolute event rates, effect estimates, confidence intervals, or a bibliography.

The infographic intentionally compresses clinical-policy content and duplicates several dosing and safety statements from the companion pocket guide; the two documents retain separate publication identities.
The HFmrEF line visually reads “LVEF ≤41-49%,” whereas the companion pocket guide defines HFmrEF as LVEF 41-49%; this was treated as a source ambiguity rather than silently corrected in the atom set.
The infographic was produced in 2024; current HFpEF policy should be checked against the 2026 ACC HFpEF ECDP.
No independent human verification was performed in this extraction run; atoms remain marked needs_review.
schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated guideline_recommendation or clinical_practice_recommendation atom kind. Recommendation, dosing, contraindication, caution, and workflow assertions were therefore represented primarily as atom_kind=other with descriptive tags and source-appropriate context.

The schema has no dedicated field for guideline class of recommendation or evidence grade; displayed COR values were preserved in canonical statements, exposure details, and tags rather than invented as structured evidence metadata.
